QuestInfo.name: To Kyle
QuestInfo.0: Kyle may be distressed as well over his encounter with Magnus. You might as well try to console him, too.
QuestInfo.1:
Give words of consolation to Kyle as well.
#bKyle#k should be at the #bHeliseum Hideout#k.
QuestInfo.2: During your friendly talk with Kyle, Velderoth seemed angered. Velderoth left Pantheon, declaring the Heliseum Force is now disbanded.
